extracted.name: Crushed Pineapple Sour Cream Pie
extracted.description: For this luscious pie, crushed pineapple, vanilla pudding mix, sour cream and sugar are stirred together and poured into a prepared crust. Chill for a few hours and decorate with candied ginger and whipped cream.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) can crushed pineapple with juice
1 (3.5 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
instruction_lines: In a large mixing bowl, combine pineapple, dry pudding mix, and sugar. Stir well, then add sour cream. Beat on low speed for 2 minutes.
Pour mixture into prepared pie shell. Chill before serving. Garnish as desired.
